# Unwind Code

Canonical URL: https://www.unwindcode.ai/

Unwind Code is an AI + Web3 architecture lab building governed AI organisms: memory-bearing, approval-gated systems that can perceive, decide, act, and improve while leaving proof humans can inspect.

## Core Concepts

- AI organisms: self-evolving systems with cortex, memory, gateway, cells, safety boundaries, and proof.
- Organisms vs apps: apps usually execute flows and reset context; AI organisms carry state forward, route work through cells, pause at risk gates, preserve proof, and improve under human authority.
- Organism Stack: Cortex, Memory, Gateway, Immune System, Cells, and Proof Loop.
- Architecture operating model: a request enters through Gateway, Cortex reasons with Memory, Cells do bounded work, Immune System allows/pauses/refuses, and Proof Loop records evidence.
- Proof Loop: public transmissions, architecture artifacts, safety gates, status labels, tests, and release evidence.
- Human approval: filesystem writes, money movement, and public posting require explicit approval.
- Web3 simulation: financial organisms are research and simulation first, with no hidden wallet authority and no broadcast path by default.
- Operating doctrine: money as armor, clarity before motion, proof before claims, human authority, replaceable cells, and Web3 simulation before live authority.

It names the Web3 research organism's read, simulate, packet, and approval-lock boundaries across input, output, memory, tool authority, approval, blocked claims, and proof routes before the trust-layer map and simulation console ask for trust.

It explains how Financial Organisms keep on-chain intelligence off-chain until approval is explicit: read-only context, simulation, risk interpretation, unsigned review, creator approval, and locked broadcast by default.

It shows how generated code, filesystem writes, money movement, public publishing, and Web3 broadcast requests stay behind sandbox, review, approval, publish-packet, and no-broadcast boundaries.
- The Trust Diligence Console is a lightweight, textless SVG with native radio controls on the proof page. It routes builders, investors, users, protocols, and collaborators to evidence paths, authority boundaries, and next inspection routes before trust turns into action.
- The Asset Governance Ledger is a lightweight, textless SVG with semantic proof cards on the proof page. It shows how visuals pass purpose, text, motion, and discovery governance before becoming public proof surfaces, so immersive assets clarify the organism architecture instead of becoming decoration.
- Asset rule: immersive visuals should improve comprehension, trust, product navigation, or proof. They must not hide critical text inside images, must respect reduced motion, and should avoid unnecessary dependencies.

## Operating Doctrine

The philosophy page explains how the prime directive becomes product constraints: lower suffering, increase clarity, preserve human authority, require proof, keep cells replaceable, and treat on-chain intelligence as simulation-first until a human approves motion. The Operating Doctrine Compass turns the doctrine into selectable governance controls for clarity, authority, money as armor, proof, and preserving the light, each with a signal, product constraint, boundary, and inspection route.

## Vision Roadmap

The vision page frames intelligence that evolves as a staged proof roadmap rather than a blank promise of autonomy. The public sequence is proof-first architecture, Infinity Mirror, Visual Cortex, Financial Organisms, Brain Cell Architecture, 2028 culture-bearing intelligence through Uncuba.ai, and 2030 governed machine coordination. The Vision Roadmap Observatory turns that roadmap into public proof, product organisms, Web3 value, and culture horizon lanes with capability, proof gate, authority boundary, and next route checks. The invariants are human authority, public proof, Web3 simulation before motion, replaceable cells, and identity continuity.
